notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting Cards (8): Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty. Total is 60 as published.
The lone '-' line in the starting section is a separator, not a card.

Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition); 'Coruscant Imperial City' Coruscant: Imperial City; 'Coruscant Docking Bay' Coruscant: Docking Bay; 'Death Star Docking Bay 327' Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'Prepared Defences' Prepared Defenses; 'Mobilisation Points' Mobilization Points.

Posted 'Crush The Rebellion (Default)' dested the printed Crush The Rebellion (Enhanced Cloud City), not the virtual card; '(Default)' marks it as the default starting Effect pulled with the Objective.
Posted 'Emperor Palpatine x6' dested the Death Star II Emperor Palpatine; the strategy says not to use the Reflections II version.
Secret Plans was an Effect in 2001 (Special Edition), not a Defensive Shield.

Results in the post: Alex Tennet went 3-0 at the UK National Championship (the strategy also mentions games 4 and 5 of his national and says the deck lost no games there; game 4 was against Michael Riboulet); John Arendt won the Colorado State Championship with it; Charlie Herren won the Georgia State Championship with his own version; Steven Lewis went 4-0 (final included) at the Tennessee State Championship with a variant.
player_note: The post says Alex Tennet went 3-0 at the UK National Championship with this deck (the strategy says it lost no games there), and that John Arendt won the Colorado State Championship with it.
